profile.headline: Software Development Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary: My main motivation is using state-of-the-art technologies at environments that prioritize best practices and agile development.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer II
positions.description: Developer inside the Amazon Kids organization, in a team that works with the Amazon for Kids Tablet, focused on providing new colorful and whimsical interactions between the tablet and kids.

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer II
positions.description: Joined the Amazon Kids organization in a team that is working on ways to provide kids connected experiences, and to let parents manage those experiences seamlessly.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description: Software Developer Engineer II in the Books organisation. We work to improve the user's organisation of their books in Android, iPhone and Kindle.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description: Developer in a small and multidisciplinary team, for both the in-house Java framework and front-end development, which uses Handlebars, LESS, Backbone and jQuery as its main components.

positions.title: Linux Developer
positions.description: Worked in the main product of the company, Lynx, an automated fraud-detection real-time artificial intelligence for banking operations.

positions.title: Analyst/Programmer
positions.description: Analyst-Programmer using Oracle WebCenter Sites, hired by Randstad to work alongside a Capgemini team for a Santalucía project.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Programmer using Oracle WebCenter Sites. Worked simultaneously in projects for companies such as EBT, Caja Los Andes, Campofrío, Consalud, Universidad del Magdalena Universidad Pontificia Bolivariana and Coomeva. Also worked in the offices of El Corte Inglés Viajes.
